Oracle Fusion Supply Chain & Manufacturing 26B: what changed

We track 25 Supply Chain & Manufacturing changes in 26B, out of 320 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 22 of them are delivered switched on; 3 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Then one plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs. Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Read issue #1 (26C) → · Privacy

Oracle sources: demand26b 26B What's New · Inventory Management 26B What's New · Maintenance 26B What's New · Manufacturing 26B What's New · Order Management 26B What's New · Product Lifecycle Management 26B What's New · Supply Chain Collaboration 26B What's New · Supply Planning 26B What's New · Sales and Operations Planning 26B What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Former opt-ins now standard in 26B

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list: features whose opt-in period ended with 26B. If you already opted in and finished setup, nothing changes. Oracle's list groups these under its own Pillar column; here they are shown by product. All former opt-ins now standard in 26B →

Delivered switched on (22)

Calculate the Cost of Products After Assigning Phantom Subassembly Materials and Resources to Operations

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
If you're a manufacturing enterprise and want granular control and auditability over the components consumed as part of the phantom subassembly in production process, you can now cost the materials and resources consumed in the phantom subassembly with the correct operation.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Review and Select Lot and Serial Numbers from an ASN or Transfer Order during Receipt

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Receiving
When you receive lot- or serial-controlled goods against an ASN or transfer order, you can now review and pick the specific lot and serial numbers you're receiving, instead of accepting every number on the document.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Selected Product Management Bug Fixes In This Update

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingProduct Lifecycle Management · Product Management
Oracle's list of 26B Product Lifecycle Management fixes that change behavior. For example, item revision attachments created or updated by import or REST now honor the needs-approval rule and create a change order.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AI Agent: Configuration Advisor

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Configure to Order
Use an AI agent to help you identify the optimal configuration for a configured item according to your inputs. Use the agent to compare two or more configurations and select the best one.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Account for Component Scrap in Work Order Costs Without Material Returns

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now scrap an already issued component to a work order without having to do a component return. You can move the scrapped item to a specific subinventory where it can be reviewed before a final disposition.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Calculate and Track Product Costs when Using an Item Multiple Times in a Discrete Work Order Operation

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
If you use an item multiple times in a discrete work order operation or in a flow schedule, you can now calculate your product costs and cost the transactions. Additionally, if you use standard cost, you can track variances by the item and basis type.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Calculate the Costs of Standard Costed Configured Items On Demand

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now calculate and publish the costs of all your configured items, even if those items don't have a new work order or purchase order in the application, if you use the standard cost method to value your inventory.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Complete the Same Output Across Multiple Operations in Discrete Manufacturing

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now add co-products and by-products to different operations in a discrete work definition or work order, with enhanced support for accurate cost calculations.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enable Accurate Capture and Fiscal Processing for Prepayments Under the New Tax Regime

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Fiscal Document Capture
In Brazil, a new Prepayment fiscal flow for purchase orders lets you record, tax and track supplier prepayments before goods arrive, and applies them to the final invoice.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Perform Lot Split, Merge, or Translate Transactions Using a Redwood Page

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
Lot split, merge and translate transactions can now be done on a Redwood page, for example splitting off the damaged part of a lot under a new lot number, or merging several lots into one.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Use the All Organizations Option When Selecting an Organization

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
Many Inventory Management pages now offer an All organizations option in the organization chooser, so managers can see data across every organization they have access to.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Levels and Attributes Using a New User Experience

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingSales and Operations Planning · Demand Management
A Redwood Levels and Attributes page for planning dimension hierarchies: rename levels for tables and graphs, choose which member identifier to show, add or delete item and organization attributes, and search by dimension, hierarchy and level.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Measures Using the Expression Builder and Measure Context

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingSales and Operations Planning · Demand Management
With Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Planning, you can configure your own measures to analyze aggregated and disaggregated data for your environment. In this update, the Redwood user experience to manage measures has been enhanced so that you can quickly configure measure expressions and edit-lock expressions using an enhanced expression builder.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Manage Levels and Attributes Using a New User Experience

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingSupply Planning · Supply Planning
A Redwood Levels and Attributes page for planning dimension hierarchies: rename levels for tables and graphs, choose which member identifier to show, add or delete item and organization attributes, and search by dimension, hierarchy and level.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

With Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Planning, you can configure your own measures to analyze aggregated and disaggregated data for your environment. Redwood: Manage Measures Using the Expression Builder and Measure Context

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & Manufacturingdemand26b · Demand Management

In this update, the Redwood user experience to manage measures has been enhanced so that you can quickly configure measure expressions and edit-lock expressions using an enhanced expression builder.

Redwood: Simulate Demand Using Additional Details

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & Manufacturingdemand26b · Demand Management
Using the Simulate demand drawer from pivot tables in demand and demand and supply plans, you can select a forecasting profile; select output measures, forecasting methods, and levels; and run a simulation that produces decomposed results (totals and by forecasting methods).
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Derive Receivables and Payables Accounts for External Trade Events Using Transaction Account Definition

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Supply Chain Financial Orchestration
Receivables and Payables accounts for external trade events in Supply Chain Financial Orchestration can now be derived with a Transaction Account Definition, not only from the control accounts on the financial agreement.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Generate Intercompany Events for Oracle Transportation Management Interface for Customer Drop Shipments

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Supply Chain Financial Orchestration
Supply Chain Financial Orchestration now publishes a Transfer Pricing business event for shipment-driven flows, including customer drop shipments, that other systems such as OTM and GTM can subscribe to.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Export All Search Results on the Completed Transactions Page

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onSupply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Inventory Management
The Completed Transactions page has a new Export All button that downloads every search result, not just the rows on screen.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Track Costs for Parallel Work Order Operations Using Precedence Constraints

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)Supply Chain & ManufacturingInventory Management · Cost Management
You can now plan for your product costs when your work definitions have parallel operations enabled. This allows for accurate calculation of your product costs, when using the standard cost method.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (3)

Redwood: Execute Work Order Operations with Enhanced Options

Impact on upgrade: highOpt-in, expires 26CSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Manufacturing
More options when executing work order operations on Redwood pages: inspect rejected quantities, see transactional item attributes, and upload attachments during execution. An opt-in in 26B that becomes standard in 26C.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Pause and Resume Operations During Production Execution Without Workstations

Impact on upgrade: highOpt-in, expires 26CSupply Chain & ManufacturingManufacturing · Manufacturing
Operators can now start, pause (with a reason) and resume work order operations in flows without workstations, and run and stop times are tracked accurately. An opt-in in 26B that becomes standard in 26C.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Set Up Customer Pricing

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleOpt-in, expires 26DSupply Chain & ManufacturingOrder Management · PricingRedwood Platform
A new Redwood Customer Pricing page in Pricing Administration lets you set prices and pricing rules for a customer, account or group of customers, with effective dates. It's an opt-in in 26B and, per Oracle's opt-in expiration list, becomes standard (switched on) in 26D.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

All 320 Supply Chain & Manufacturing features in Oracle's 26B What's New

Every row of the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area, with Oracle's own "Impact to Existing Processes" and "Action to Enable" columns as Oracle states them: 124 on by default, 31 on by default with potential setup, 86 setup required, 75 opt-in, 4 needing another action. Oracle's legend: features whose impact is "None" are not delivered enabled and need steps to use; "Potential Setup" means there is prerequisite or optional configuration to consider.
